changes.title: Cauldron slice
items: A cauldron preview adds mushroom collecting, shared kitchen baskets and a temporary mirror-floor brew.

changes.title: Sigil cache
items: Creature sigils reuse their prepared shapes when drawn again.

changes.title: Travel logs
items: Travel logs give more detail about loading pauses.

changes.title: Save resume night
items: Your night is saved as you play. Return to the same version to resume where you left off.
Resuming takes you straight back into play. A new night is saved once you're out of bed.

changes.title: Multiplayer groundwork
items: Multiplayer groundwork: the rules can step several witches independently, sharing the night clock and pausing only when everyone pauses. Online play is still to come.

changes.title: Unlock hats
items: Unlock everything now puts every spell hat on the Cloakroom floor.
